_about: Herbert Weir Smyth (1857-1937), Professor of Greek at Bryn Mawr and later Harvard, raw IA OCR: The Dialects of North Greece (Baltimore: Isaac Friedenwald, 1887, reprinted from the American Journal of Philology); The Sounds and Inflections of the Greek Dialects: Ionic (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1894); Greek Melic Poets (Macmillan, 1900). His Loeb Aeschylus is on the aeschylus shelf from Perseus. Greek-dense volumes kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling. Classical scholarship (lane B, round dv). No uids minted.
